entries.title: Psalms 113:1
segments: ¶Praise the LORD! Praise, O servants of the LORD, Praise the name of the LORD!

entries.title: Psalms 113:2
segments: Blessed be the name of the LORD From this time forth and forevermore!

entries.title: Psalms 113:3
segments: From the rising of the sun to its going down The LORD'S name [is] to be praised.

entries.title: Psalms 113:4
segments: The LORD [is] high above all nations, His glory above the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 113:5
segments: Who [is] like the LORD our God, Who dwells on high,

entries.title: Psalms 113:6
segments: Who humbles Himself to behold [The things that are] in the heavens and in the earth?

entries.title: Psalms 113:7
segments: He raises the poor out of the dust, [And] lifts the needy out of the ash heap,

entries.title: Psalms 113:8
segments: That He may seat [him] with princes-With the princes of His people.

entries.title: Psalms 113:9
segments: He grants the barren woman a home, Like a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD!
